boulders.name: Bardini Boulder
boulders.approach: From A Maze ofDeath Boulder walk West along the hillside until you come across this giant hunk of rock!

boulders.name: Maze of Death Boulder

boulders.name: The McNugget
boulders.approach: Up the hill from the warmups about 50 yards, the good climbs face up hill.

boulders.name: Rex Kwon Do Boulder
boulders.approach: Just east of the Bardini Boulder in a cluster of four.

boulders.name: Psyche Transfer
boulders.approach: Just east of walkabout 4

boulders.name: Walkabout 4
boulders.approach: Get to the walkabout boulders and trend south to the last one before the bottom drops out of the valley. Right at the edge of the col.

boulders.name: Warmup Boulders
boulders.approach: About 100 yards west of the Bardini Boulder

boulders.name: Brown Wall Boulder

boulders.name: Form Destroyer Roof Boulder
boulders.approach: From the main trail heading towards the Secrets Area, about directly uphill from the massive Luminance block.(Luminance on left, Form Destroyer uphill on right.) Climb the gravelly steep hill to a large boulder which…

boulders.name: Luminance Block
boulders.approach: Park at the Beehive parking and walk in between the domes as for the rest of The Beehive climbs. While walking towards Secrets of the Beehive or The Swarm/ Brown Wall Boulder, this boulder will be located down a deep…

boulders.name: The Flake Crack Boulder
boulders.approach: Just left of the boulder at the base of the Secrets Boulder (the middle boulder)

boulders.name: Natural Melody Boulder
boulders.approach: After entering the cave, to left around the Nectar Boulder until the obvious scoops.

boulders.name: Queen Sweet Nectar Boulder
boulders.approach: Secrets of the Beehive Area

boulders.name: Secrets of the Beehive Boulder
boulders.approach: Secrets of the Beehive area

boulders.name: Bachar Boulder
boulders.approach: Hike up the hill from the lower parking area past the Grandma Peabody and up to the right towards the east side of the Drifter/Smoking boulders.

boulders.name: Birthday Boulders
boulders.approach: From Buttermilk Road, drive up the hill with the boulders on your right, go over a cattle guard and make an immediate right. Take your next right into the parking area/loop. The Birthday Boulders are the closest to the…

boulders.name: Bowling Pin Boulder
boulders.approach: From the Birthday Boulders parking area, traverse the hillside eastwards for 100+ yards. It's just uphill from the Tut Boulder. The boulder is easily spotted when viewed from the east.

boulders.name: Boy and Girl Rocks
boulders.approach: From the parking loop in the Buttermilks Main Area, follow the marked trail above Birthday Boulders past Loaf (on left), to Pope's Hat (on left). Boy and Girl rocks are on your right, immediately downhill of Pope's Hat.…

boulders.name: Buttermilk Stem Boulder
boulders.approach: Rowell Rocks Area, just uphill from Rowell Rock, on the main path that runs east/west across the hillside.

boulders.name: Pothole Boulder
boulders.approach: 30 feet east of Rowell Rock

boulders.name: Rowell Rock
boulders.approach: Just downhill from the 'Buttermilk Stem Boulder', 30 feet West of the 'Pothole Boulder'. This is the largest boulder in the group.

boulders.name: Buttermilks Dome
boulders.approach: walk around or scramble behind iron man

boulders.name: Buttocks/Smooth Shrimp Boulder
boulders.approach: Walk a short distance Northwest from the Pope's Prow/Mandala Boulder

boulders.name: Cave Boulder
boulders.approach: Cave Area of the Buttermilks.

boulders.name: Robinson's Rubber Tester Boulder
boulders.approach: The boulder down hill from 'Soul Slinger'.

boulders.name: Soul Slinger Boulder
boulders.approach: Small boulder just northeast of the Cave Boulder.

boulders.name: Corner Boulders
boulders.approach: Between the Petroglyph Boulder and the Tut Boulder. The cluster of boulders just down slope and southwest of the Tut Boulder.

boulders.name: Drifter/Smoking Boulder
boulders.approach: Walk up hill from the Peabody Boulders.

boulders.name: Fit Homeless Boulder
boulders.approach: From The Cave Area , head up the slope, passing Soul Slinger to reach the boulder.

boulders.name: Green Wall Boulder
boulders.approach: From the parking area for the Peabody Boulders, head up the main trail passing the Peabodies to your right. The Green Wall Boulder is up on the left above the Sunshine Boulder. Look for the beautiful north face with the…

boulders.name: Grovel Roof Boulder
boulders.approach: From the Iron Man Boulder, walk downhill and southeast about 20 yards. Grovel Roof will be on your left on the steepest side of the boulder facing downhill (south).

boulders.name: The Hunk
boulders.approach: From the Green Wall Boulder, look uphill and to the right: the boulder is pretty big and tough to miss. The boulder problem 'The Hunk' is on the right side of the north (uphill) face.

boulders.name: Hero Roof Boulder
boulders.approach: From the Birthday Boulders parking area, walk east about 50 yards past the Pope's Hat Boulder and Boy and Girl Rocks until you reach the overhanging face on your right. The trail goes directly under 'Hero Roof'.

boulders.name: Iron Man Boulder
boulders.approach: Walk past the 'Hero Roof Boulder' and it'll be up on your left about 30 feet.

boulders.name: The Golden Boulder
boulders.approach: If you are looking at the "Iron Man Traverse", look off to your right and you will see a very large boulder with a unique crack system near the bottom of it. There is also a smaller boulder which is adjacent to a long…

boulders.name: Hager Boulder
boulders.approach: 30 yards up and to the east of the Iron Man Boulder

boulders.name: The Loaf
boulders.approach: Just north of Birthday Boulders near the main parking area.

boulders.name: Lower Smoking Boulder
boulders.approach: Walk around the backside of The Drifter Boulder.

boulders.name: Mandala/Pope's Prow Boulder
boulders.approach: Walk uphill from the Drifter Boulder.

boulders.name: Mini Boulder
boulders.approach: Hike to High Plains Drifter. From there it is directly east of the Womb boulder.

boulders.name: Never Trust a Man-Bun Boulder
boulders.approach: Hike to the girl rock routes and turn around.

boulders.name: Grandma Peabody Boulder
boulders.approach: Walk up from the parking lot.

boulders.name: Grandpa Peabody Boulder
boulders.approach: From the Peabody parking area (lower parking), open your eyes

boulders.name: Peewee Boulder
boulders.approach: Walk toward Grandpa Peabody, but head to the little boulder on the right.

boulders.name: Pinch Boulder
boulders.approach: Park for the Peabodies and hike uphill past Highplains before heading east.

boulders.name: Pope's Hat
boulders.approach: Walk east, passing the south end of The Loaf to this boulder.

boulders.name: Ranger Rock
boulders.approach: Walk east from the west parking area.

boulders.name: Roadside Boulder
boulders.approach: From the parking area follow the path up and left directly towards the boulder.

boulders.name: Scoop Boulder
boulders.approach: From the parking area walk up and leftwards towards the boulders.

boulders.name: Saigon Boulder
boulders.approach: From the Peabody Parking Area, walk up the main trail past the Green Wall Boulder. From here the Saigon Boulder can be seen as the highest boulder on the hill. The route 'Saigon' will be the gently overhanging…

boulders.name: Sharma Traverse Boulder
boulders.approach: Directly uphill from Smooth Shrimp and Mandala

boulders.name: Stained Glass/Flyboy Area
boulders.approach: From the Birthday Boulder parking area, head north up the hill, left and behind the Birthday Boulders and up past The Loaf.

boulders.name: Sunshine Boulder
boulders.approach: Hike uphill to the northwest from the Peabodys.

boulders.name: Tut Boulder
boulders.approach: The boulder is situated below the Bowling Pin Boulder , just south of the East / West path.

boulders.name: Twins Boulders
boulders.approach: From the Iron Man Boulder, walk downhill and southeast about 40 yards, past Grovel Roof

boulders.name: Upside Boulder
boulders.approach: Walk uphill 5 minutes from the Saigon Boulder.

boulders.name: Womb Boulder
boulders.approach: Walk about 50' NNE from The Drifter Boulder.

boulders.name: Beyond the Edge of Reason Boulder
boulders.approach: Head uphill from either Checkerboard or Edge of Reason. It looks like a little loaf, but the east side holds a proud problem. About five minutes of uphill sand and your're there.

boulders.name: The Checkerboard Boulder
boulders.approach: Checkerboard Area

boulders.name: Chess Boulder
boulders.approach: Checkerboard area of the Buttermilks.

boulders.name: Edge of Reason Boulder
boulders.approach: From the Checkerboard Boulder hike down into the deep ravine and up the other side. This boulder is the next one visible.

boulders.name: The Knight Boulder
boulders.approach: In the Checkerboard area.

boulders.name: Overseer Boulders
boulders.approach: Hike straight up the hill from The Checkerboard to the small cluster of large boulders on the very top of the hillside.

boulders.name: The A-Team Boulders
boulders.approach: The approach is easy, as these boulders are some of the most Northern rocks in Dale's Camp. Just walk slightly Northeast of the Small Fruit Boulders, or Southwest of the Heart Prow Boulder.

boulders.name: Green Hornet Boulder
boulders.approach: A couple hundred yards or so west of Dale's Dome in the trees.

boulders.name: Zen Flute Boulder
boulders.approach: 75 yards downhill and to the northwest of the 'Green Hornet Boulder'. 'Zen Flute' v10 faces uphill towards 'Green Hornet' (the first problem you see).

boulders.name: Girls of Whiskey Creek Boulder

boulders.name: Xav's Roof Boulder

boulders.name: Small Fruit Boulder

boulders.name: Chicken Head Boulder
boulders.approach: Approach just as you would for Heart Prow or Zeppelin Area.

boulders.approach: From the 'Zeppelin Boulder', head thru the cave and down the hill southeast for 30 yards. It's the lowest boulder on the slope and one of the biggest around. Or, continue up the hill from the parking area around the…

boulders.name: The Ghost of Dale Bard
boulders.approach: Just uphill from the Led Zeppelin Boulder.

boulders.name: Heart Prow Boulder
boulders.approach: From Zeppelin, hike around the hill to the northeast.

boulders.name: Led Zeppelin Boulder
boulders.approach: If walking up past the 'Cuban Roll Boulder', head up the hill and slightly right maybe 30 yards. There's a smaller, flatter boulder touching it on the right side ('Little Zeppelin Boulder').

boulders.name: Get Carter Boulder
boulders.approach: Drive past the Birthday Boulders parking lot and turn right. Follow this down the hill until you see the boulder on the right, 10 feet off the road.

boulders.name: The Glass House
boulders.approach: Just up the hill from the parking

boulders.name: The Green Room

boulders.name: Snake Eyes Boulder
boulders.approach: Just up the hill from the parking, down and left from the Glass House

boulders.name: Hall of Mirrors
boulders.approach: Drive out past Dale's Camp. Continue on the dirt road past a spur road that takes you uphill to the south (and goes past another obscure bouldering area known as the Glass House.) The main road continues up a canyon…

boulders.name: Cracked Boulder

boulders.name: Creek Boulder

boulders.name: Iron Woman

boulders.name: The Mustache Ride

boulders.name: The Pit Boulder

boulders.name: Cracked Cobble Boulder
boulders.approach: Continue walking uphill and west from the Beekeeper area another couple hundred feet to reach this cluster of hidden boulders at the col.

boulders.name: The Hive Boulder
boulders.approach: Continue uphill from the Apiary boulders 1 min.

boulders.name: Honey Boulder

boulders.name: Jedi Boulder

boulders.name: Lidija / Pollen Grain Boulder
boulders.approach: Drive past the Get Carter Boulder on road 7SO4 and park in the designated area. Then, approach towards the higher ground, contouring the side of the hill, on a southernly bearing. This will be the first boulder you…

boulders.name: Mead Boulder
boulders.approach: Walk west from Spectre.

boulders.name: The Ninth Boulder
boulders.approach: Slog your way up the hill. There does not appear to be any distinct trails or an easy way up.

boulders.name: Spectre Boulder
boulders.approach: From the Pollen Grain parking area walk up the trail and follow it as it curves slightly to the right once gaining the ridge/plateau. The Spectre is one of the first problems that becomes visible just to the right of…

boulders.name: White Slab Boulder
boulders.approach: Approach from the Apiary/Hive boulders. 2-5 mins uphill. The Ninth is clearly visible from White Slab.

boulders.name: Possibly Disasterous
boulders.approach: Follow directions for the Get Carter Boulder, but continue down the road as if you were going to the Pollen Grains. At the first intersection after the Get Carter Boulder, where one turns right to go towards the Pollen…

boulders.name: The Sexy Bloc
boulders.approach: From downtown Bishop follow the highway 7.2 miles to the Buttermilks road entrance. Drive approximately 2 miles and take a right on an obscure dirt road to the right (immediately after crossing McGee Creek).Follow this…

boulders.name: Sherman Acres
boulders.approach: Drive up the Buttermilk road past the Peabodies all the way past Grouse Mountain. There is a tricky creek crossing. Shortly after this creek crossing, take a small road on the left that goes downhill towards Grouse…

boulders.name: Boneyard Area
boulders.approach: Walk as for the Painted Cave area, but keep following the path which leads towards the distant Grouse Mountain. Grouse Mountain appears in between two pillar like rock formations. This is also the way to get to…

boulders.name: Charlie Brown Boulders
boulders.approach: From Painted Cave walk west towards a boulder cluster.Hard to miss the prominent horizontal cracks and the two touching large boulders.

boulders.name: Slashface Boulder
boulders.approach: This boulder is kind of hidden from view due to a large rock formation seen from the trail. Best way to get to it is to go down the sandy slab going southwest so you can come up to the northside of the boulder.

boulders.name: Xen Boulder
boulders.approach: As for "Painted Cave", but while looking at the problem turn around and look in the distance and slightly right. There is a run-off/ drainage scoop with some boulders in it. This boulder lies slightly uphill from there.…

boulders.name: Solitaire Boulder
boulders.approach: Just before the cattle guard before the Birthday boulders parking, turn left and park at the end of the road. Cross the creek and head up the other side. Hang a left through a small wash, then start to your right…
